The '''S6-series security and maintenance droid''' was a common security observation droid used throughout the galaxy around the time of the [[Old Sith Wars]]. The small, spherical droid were seen in great numbers throughout the galaxy, though mostly unnoticed by the average sentients, making them excellent for surveillance and espionage.

Each droid had a long antennae and multiple mini-[[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]]. It could repair other droids or vehicles, even in the midst of combat, or it could act as a mobile security camera with its advanced sensory equipment.

The [[Leviathan (Interdictor-class cruiser)|''Leviathan'']] had a complement of maintenance droids flying around near the bridge. [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], [[Carth Onasi]], and [[Bastila Shan]] came across many of these models during their escape from the starship.
